fusions.name: Many Arms
fusions.desc: Looses 8 links at once, fanned wide, each dealing 3 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Constricting Ring
fusions.desc: Cinches every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage, knocking each back 3 tiles and leaving each with an 80% chance of [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Arms Wrapped
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. An escort of links fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spare Hand
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1 second.
